name: DESCHUTES TITLE
address: 397 SW UPPER TERRACE DR, BEND, OR 97702

fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the locations of any gate latches or locks on the perimeter fencing so responders can locate them quickly without searching.
• Keep all perimeter gates unlocked or secured only with a breakaway lock to allow responder access without delay.
• Trim dense vegetation along the access drive to maintain clear sightlines and allow emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Clear a turnaround area near the main residence large enough for an emergency vehicle to reverse direction without backing long distances.
• Keep the area around the detached structure clear of parked vehicles so responders can approach and work around all sides.
• Mark or communicate to responders which access point provides the most direct route to the detached structure.
• Trim vegetation along walkways connecting the main residence to the detached structure so responders can move quickly on foot between the two.
• Keep both vehicle parking areas clear of stored items that could block emergency vehicle positioning or movement.
• Post the property address visibly at the access drive entrance and again near the main residence entrance in case responders enter from different directions.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the scattered tree clusters nearest to the structure to create more open space between individual trees.
• Trim low-hanging branches on trees closest to the structure to reduce the path fire can travel from the ground up into the tree canopy.
• Remove or cut back shrubs that are growing directly against or touching the structure.
• Clear ground vegetation such as dry grass and weeds within the immediate area surrounding the structure.
• Separate any shrubs growing beneath or adjacent to trees to break the connection between low plants and tree branches.
• Keep the open terrain areas between scattered trees and the structure free of accumulated dead plant material.
• Maintain the existing open green space by mowing or cutting ground vegetation regularly to keep it short and reduce the amount of burnable material on the ground.
• Thin shrubs growing in clusters near any outbuildings or secondary structures on the property.
• Remove dead branches and dead plant material from the base of trees located near the structure.
